verdict.rationale: Meilisearch offers LLM-backed conversational search, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it, but the pack contains no evidence that it can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools. The MCP evidence (the native server at POST /mcp, and natural-language index management from AI clients) describes the opposite role: Meilisearch serving tools to other agents. That belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
